db/query#

Queries: run a statement and take its rows.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let user = await db.query("SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = ?", DbInteger(7)).one();
let found = await db.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?", DbText("Ada")).maybe();
let page = await db.query("SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY id").all(100);

let rows = await Query(origin: db, statement: Statement("SELECT * FROM big")).rows();
loop {
    match await rows.next() {
        case Maybe.some(row) { row.text("title"); }
        else { last; }
    }
}
rows.close();

Description#

Queries: run a statement and take its rows.

one() wants exactly one row (NoRows, TooManyRows), maybe() at most one, all(limit) at most limit (QueryLimitExceeded beyond). Each call runs the statement anew.

Public API#

object Query#

object Query does DbQuery

Each call executes the statement anew. Owns its cursor, not the connection.
